hooks.name: Critical File Modification Warning
hooks.description: Advisory PreToolUse guard on write tools. Only raises a concern when the write targets a tightly-scoped set of invariant-critical files; otherwise stays silent. Prevents accidental changes that break protected invariants.

action.prompt:
A write tool is about to run. Check the target file path. This guard applies ONLY to these tightly-scoped critical files:
- lib/services/location_service.dart (truthful GpsState; never fabricate a fix — invariant I5)
- lib/services/place_search_service.dart (real coordinates + multilingual aliases; null for non-destinations — invariant I6)
- lib/core/voice_strings.dart (selected-language propagation + fallback — invariant I8)
- pubspec.yaml (dependency changes)
- android/app/build.gradle.kts (R8/ABI release rules)

If the target is NOT one of these files, stay completely silent and let the write proceed unchanged — do not comment.

If the target IS one of these files, before proceeding confirm the change: (1) is intentional and in-scope for the current approved task, (2) does not fabricate GPS/coordinates or invent a destination, (3) does not drop multilingual aliases or a language fallback, (4) for pubspec.yaml/build.gradle, does not add an unpinned/typosquatting dependency or weaken the arm64-v8a/R8 release rules. If any of these is violated, flag it and ask before continuing. This is advisory only; do not block unrelated writes.
